description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
When Puppeteer Clique enters, it triggers, putting a creature from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
